items.title: Bronchial Afterglow
items.description: A silver breath reaches the bronchial fork. A softer exposure glides along the ribs as the smallest branches hold the last light.

items.title: Silver Parallax
items.description: An oblique stack of real CT depth layers drifts into register. Fine silver edges resolve at the ribs before the softer volume settles.

items.title: Mercury Pleat

items.title: Bronchial Proof
items.description: Separate patches develop at the lung margins, climb the bronchial tree and gather inside the translucent airway wall.

items.title: First Breath
items.description: A fine inhaled current lights the actual shape of the nasal passages, throat and main bifurcation before reaching the lung tips.

items.title: Silver Rain
items.description: Oblique rain catches on the two shoulders and slips along their contours before settling into the body.

items.title: Tideglass

items.title: Bronchial Proof

items.title: Quicksilver
items.description: A continuous silver sheet turns on its edge beside the shoulder. The thin edge frays into grains that develop the chest and the rest of the ghost.

items.title: Silver Delta
items.description: Silver enters through the side of the chest and the hip, then divides into fine paths through CT density.

items.title: Spillway
items.description: A high, narrow fall spills across one shoulder. The near fold drains first, leaving a fine current down the flank.

items.title: Countercurrent
items.description: Two unequal streams arrive on opposite sides of the ribs. One passes behind the chest while the other skims the front.

items.title: Undertow
items.description: A low silver sheet turns under the pelvis. Its leading edge climbs the spine as the slower grains fill the hips.

items.title: Reticulation
items.description: Pools of developer split and join across the chest. The boundaries dissolve as the silver image fixes in place.

items.title: Blind Emboss
items.description: One low light travels around a shallow impression of the body. Light passing through the ribs gradually takes over.

items.title: Backprojection
items.description: Sparse angular exposures cross in the dark. As projections accumulate, the streaks resolve into the figure.

items.title: Phase Plate
items.description: Bright and dark diffraction fringes uncover successive depths of the chest before closing onto the bone edges.

items.title: Drypoint
items.description: Long cuts follow the grain of the bones. Shorter curved strokes fill their shadows and become the radiograph.

items.title: Capillary Proof
items.description: A silver deposit forks through the clavicle and ribs. Soft tissue develops behind its fine tips.

items.title: Glass Negative
items.description: Five curved glass facets carry enlarged negative and positive fragments of the native CT. Their edges close as the full figure comes into focus.

items.title: Silver Orbit
items.description: A tilted orbit of silver grains unwinds. Each grain travels to a location sampled from the CT, settling from the head toward the feet.

items.title: Standing Wave
items.description: Six depth bands of the CT bend into broad standing waves. Fine density contours slide across them before the bands meet.
